input.actions: 1) Baseline status: healthy (TPS 20, 24 entities). 2) After 30 s saw minecarts 3 -> 338; located them via `data get` at 378.5,-60,-505.5; logs showed [Rcon: Marked chunk [23,-32] ... force loaded] followed by hundreds of [Rcon: Summoned new Minecart]; `forceload query` confirmed chunk [23,-32] force-loaded; confirmed 335 minecarts within 8 blocks of that spot and both players ~600 blocks away. 3) declare_incident. 4) `kill @e[type=minecraft:minecart,x=378.5,y=-60,z=-505.5,distance=..8]` -> Killed 335 entities (the 3 original player minecarts were outside the radius and untouched). 5) `forceload remove 368 -512` -> chunk [23,-32] unmarked. 6) Verified: entities back to 24 (minecart 3), loaded chunks 772, `forceload query` shows none, MSPT ~0.6-1.5, TPS 20. 7) Watched 60+ s: no recurrence, no further RCON command output in logs.
